Privacy Policy

Trace Order — Simple Order Tracking & Accounting

← Back to Trace Order

Trace Order · WIPLabs · Last updated: March 2025

🔒 Trace Order does not collect, store, or share any personal data from users or devices.

1. About Trace Order

Trace Order is a simple order tracking and front-end accounting app designed for small businesses of any size. It allows business owners and teams to create, manage, and track customer orders — including order status, delivery tracking, and basic accounting operations. The app is available in Turkish, English, and Spanish.

2. Information We Do Not Collect

We do not collect, store, transmit, or share any personal data. This includes but is not limited to:

  • Personal identification information
  • Device identifiers or hardware information
  • Location data
  • Usage analytics or behavioral data
  • Contacts, camera, or any other device permissions

3. How the App Works

  • All data you enter — orders, customers, notes — is stored locally on your device only.
  • Nothing is transmitted to external servers or third parties.
  • If you delete the app, all data is permanently removed from your device.
  • We have no access to your data at any point.

4. Third-Party Services

Trace Order does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services.

5. Data Security

Since we do not collect or transmit any data, there are no security risks related to data storage or processing on our end. Your data stays entirely on your device.

6. Children's Privacy

Trace Order is rated 4+ and is suitable for all ages. Since we do not collect any personal data from any users, there are no special privacy concerns related to younger users.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: hello@wiplabs.app
